en: Vintage postcard with a sepia-toned photograph on the right showing a grand neoclassical bank building with columns, ornate pediment, balcony, flag on the roof and a metal fence in front. The caption under the image reads "BANCA DALL' ORSO GALATI." The left side is filled with handwritten French text beginning with "Cher frère." In the upper right margin appears a printed or written date, and along the right edge a vertical imprint of the printer/publisher.
